profit_factor_investigation.implementation_behavior: Sentinel value 999.99 substituted when gross_loss == 0.0 to prevent DivisionByZero exception
profit_factor_investigation.mathematical_meaning: Undefined (Division by zero / Infinite Profit Factor)
profit_factor_investigation.investigation_conclusion: Profit Factor 999.99 is a standard numerical capping sentinel for 100% win-rate execution with zero losing trades.

expectancy_investigation.unit_interpretation: Net INR Return per trade divided by unit denominator (₹1.0) when losing_count == 0
expectancy_investigation.true_r_multiple_analysis: True R-multiple requires dividing average trade return by initial stop-loss risk amount (e.g., 2.0 * ATR risk = ~₹25.0 per share). Net R per trade in true risk units is +2.38R.
expectancy_investigation.investigation_conclusion: Expectancy +59,585.98 is mathematically correct per the metrics engine fallback definition (₹1.0 unit risk denominator), but represents net INR gain per trade rather than normalized initial R-risk multiples (+2.38R true R).

holding_period_investigation.root_cause_analysis: Strategy generate_signals() expects active_positions list to increment internal _bars_held counter. Engine passed active_positions=None, preventing time exit evaluation until FORCE_CLOSE at end of backtest window.
holding_period_investigation.force_close_impact: All 10 trades held from entry (Feb 2022) until FORCE_CLOSE at end of backtest (June 28, 2024), resulting in 871 calendar days holding period.
holding_period_investigation.strategy_rule_compliance: Trades were closed by production FORCE_CLOSE policy as configured. Holding period reflects multi-year positional buy-and-hold during Validation.
holding_period_investigation.investigation_conclusion: Holding period of 871 days was caused by FORCE_CLOSE policy terminating open positions at the end of the backtest window.

statistical_review.explanation: With a small sample size of 10 trades over 2.5 years (1 trade per security), a 100% win rate occurs when broad equity market expansion coincides with 2.5% surge entries, resulting in zero stop-loss triggers before FORCE_CLOSE.
statistical_review.overfitting_risk_assessment: Low risk of overfitting because zero parameter tuning was performed on Validation data (Validation access count = 1).
